name: Jinhua
scopeLimits: Official municipal natural-resources and immovable-property registration responsibilities and city-level registration policy were found. Jinhua’s official open-data portal was reviewed for spatial datasets; no public parcel feature schema or bounded geometry service was established. The WUP point was not matched to a district/street parcel; no owner or property query was made.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Jinhua’s official city natural-resources and planning authority is assigned natural-resource and immovable-property title registration responsibilities; Jinhua government bulletins document city-level immovable-property registration rules. These establish a local registry custodian, not open parcel-vector coverage.
technicalBlocker: No public anonymous cadastral layer or safe feature endpoint was exposed in the reviewed official services.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the exact WUP coordinate has an urban-district parcel match and whether a public map layer exists outside the reviewed city portal.
nextStep: Identify an official, anonymous parcel-map service and inspect its schema before any bounded feature query.
